description: This source file provides utility functions for file system operations, including writing to a file if content has changed, removing a specific file, and removing a directory or path if it exists.

methods.name: writeTextFileIfChanged
methods.description: Writes text to a file only if the content differs from the existing content, creating directories as needed.

methods.name: removeFileIfExists
methods.description: Removes a specified file if it exists.

methods.name: removePathIfExists
methods.description: Removes a specified directory or path recursively if it exists.
